features.backbone: Same frozen pi05 spatial 30000 checkpoint and input transforms
features.source: Existing lossless policy-input PNGs only; oracle targets at exact call_step minus root_step
features.spatial_pooling: For each of two 16x16 token grids, pool disjoint 4x4 token cells to a 4x4 spatial grid; retain order. No global image pooling for spatial head. Verify actual token layout before execution; stop if mismatch.
features.projection: Three fixed Gaussian matrices (seeds11,23,47), width2048 to32 scaled1/sqrt(32), independently of labels. Save projected 2x16x32 patches per input, not full raw token grids.
features.identity: First compare same-root global pooled features to saved prefix features <=1e-6 in float32 before float16 roundtrip, or same float16 arrays. No action inference changes. No unverified free-cache claim.

geometry_supervision.scope: Current oracle labels used only during fit supervision/evaluation. Ground-truth geometry never an online predictor.
geometry_supervision.model: Linear ridge from spatial grid1024 to6; normalize per inner training fold; per-episode equal-weight frames
geometry_supervision.selection: No grid or tuning; fold fitting excludes every held episode and all calibration.

critic.features: Predicted geometry6 at root, predicted geometry6 at factual60 for root120, delta6 and history mask1, original robot history40, executed past action28, time1 =88 dimensions; absent history zero. Fit-only normalize.
critic.model: Linear joint result3x4, L2=0.1, same loss and zero-init LBFGS150 as accepted state baseline
controls: Matched old state linear0.1 and task/time OOF references
Global-mean prefix ridge geometry with same geometry targets, projection seeds and critic
Privileged current-geometry critic as explicitly nondeployable diagnostic ceiling, same fold and regularization
critic.preparation_gate: Spatial ensemble must lower both OOF NLL and gain MSE versus task/time prior and matched global-mean geometry control; at least2/3 spatial seeds lower gain MSE versus corresponding global control. This permits preparation of a new calibration protocol only; no deployment, no original calibration risk gate relaxation.

controls.independence: No target/goal ground truth, image index, success or future frame in predictor. Freeze source-image hash and exact physical timestamp mapping. Learned geometry may be wrong/occluded; no sufficiency claim.
controls.positive: Toy image-coordinate regression with known spatial target, actual root feature identity, and original state prediction regression must pass.
controls.negative: Synthetic conditional-information null; deliberately shifted target timestamp must be rejected.
